inferred_links.I1: Mixer value text is read by the generic loader: plain decimal -> nearest binary64 -> nearest binary32, Booleans true/false, codes decimal. Not re-traced for TimeableFloat, TimeableBool, TimeableEnum or RemoteableEnum; tempo (TimeableSongTempo) is a different class, so the transport-state-v1 check does not carry over by identity. Fixture numbers are chosen so single and double rounding agree.
inferred_links.I2: The value text of an enumerated value is its entry name (PanMode, CrossFadeState, CrossfadeCurve); the enum text routine is not traced.
inferred_links.I3: LiveSet/CrossfadeCurve is the set enum the set constructor initialises with the seven names and index 2 (corpus 0x102672448); member-to-element binding untraced; consistent with 375/376 shipped sets storing 2.
inferred_links.I4: The platform log10f is within one binary32 step of the correctly rounded result; the 0.00005 dB margin and the two-step tolerance in model() cover it.
inferred_links.I5: Split pans use the pan text converter: 0x10271c734 pseudocode passes singleton 0x101439ec4 for Pan and both splits; the confirmed branch is Pan's.
inferred_links.I6: The primary text slot (+0x28: unit and -inf) is the value text a user sees in at least one place; the second slot (+0x40) form is excluded; covered by the comparison obligation.
